results.name: Disease-anchored compact dual-target module
results.hypothesis: Dual-target convergence is more credible when the shared compact process is independently associated with the disease.
results.body: R095 plus disease genetic association to the same compact process
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule establishes two inhibited causal targets in a disease-anchored molecular module, but disease-driving activity direction remains absent.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; two-target cardinality, shared-node identity, and process degree require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (gene1)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(gene2)
MATCH (object)-[:GENETIC_ASSOCIATION]-(process)
WHERE gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.body: R096 restricted to MONDO diseases with <=500 direct descendants and at least one parent
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule retains convergent perturbation of an interacting causal pair and adds a graph-structural disease-specificity constraint.
results.trapi_notes: The positive graph motif is TRAPI-expressible; two-target cardinality and ontology-degree constraints require post-processing.

results.name: Ontology-specific signed tissue pathway propagation
results.hypothesis: Signed regulatory propagation becomes more useful when broad disease ontology hubs are excluded.
results.body: R098 restricted to MONDO diseases with <=500 direct descendants and at least one parent
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines corrective signed propagation, pathway and tissue context, causal genetics, and disease specificity; disease-driver activity direction is still incomplete.
results.trapi_notes: The signed positive motif is TRAPI-expressible; shared tissue, compactness, provenance, and ontology-degree constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[regulation:REGULATES]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (target)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(driver)
MATCH (target)-[target_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (driver)-[driver_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND regulation.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND regulation.object_direction_qualifier = 'upregulated'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(target_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(driver_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 50
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Ontology-specific independent provenance architecture
results.hypothesis: Independent molecular and genetic provenance should become more actionable after excluding broad disease ontology hubs.
results.body: R100 restricted to MONDO diseases with <=500 direct descendants and at least one parent
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines a direct causal-target mechanism, independent evidence channels, and disease specificity, but lacks disease activity direction.
results.trapi_notes: The positive causal-target motif is TRAPI-expressible; source-union cardinality, derived evidence, and ontology-degree constraints require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, object, evidence, collect(DISTINCT binding) AS bindings
WITH subject, object, evidence,
     reduce(
       sources = [],
       relation IN bindings |
       reduce(
         accumulated = sources,
         source IN coalesce(relation.primary_knowledge_sources, []) |
         CASE
           WHEN source IN accumulated THEN accumulated
           ELSE accumulated + source
         END
       )
     ) AS binding_sources
WHERE size(binding_sources) >= 3
  AND evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
  AND evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 3
  AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Ontology-specific direct-lineage indication transfer
results.hypothesis: Bounded indication transfer should improve when the predicted disease is specific even if the treated anchor is broad.
results.body: R104 with candidate disease <=500 direct descendants and at least one parent
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule transfers a target mechanism only to ontology-specific candidate diseases, but a broad treated anchor can still overgeneralize.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion, bidirectional lineage, and ontology-degree constraints require Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(anchor)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE object <> anchor
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND (
    EXISTS {
      MATCH (anchor)-[:SUBCLASS_OF*1..2]->(object)
    }
    OR EXISTS {
      MATCH (object)-[:SUBCLASS_OF*1..2]->(anchor)
    }
  )
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Contradiction-gated signed tissue propagation
results.hypothesis: Explicit adverse and opposite-direction evidence can remove false positives from the ontology-specific signed propagation mechanism.
results.body: R108 excluding direct adverse disease edges, shared side-effect phenotypes, and opposite target-increase assertions
results.mechanism_rationale: The positive signed tissue-pathway mechanism is retained while graph-native contradictions are used as exclusion evidence.
results.trapi_notes: The positive motif is TRAPI-expressible; NOT EXISTS gates, shared tissue, and derived constraints require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[regulation:REGULATES]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (target)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(driver)
MATCH (target)-[target_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (driver)-[driver_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND regulation.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND regulation.object_direction_qualifier = 'upregulated'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(target_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(driver_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 50
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[opposite:AFFECTS]->(target)
    WHERE opposite.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
      AND opposite.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
      AND opposite.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
